definition_zh: 错误地；不正确地；荒谬地
definition_en: in a way that is wrong because it rests on a mistaken belief or faulty reasoning
core_image: 报表上一格小数点错位，下面整列数字跟着齐步走错，没人抬头看一眼
scene: 名单把他错列为毕业生。 The list erroneously enrolled him.
sceneCN: 这里 erroneously 是「错误地；误以为真地」（第 1 个义项：因前提有误而做错）；句意：名单误把他说成毕业生。

pos.zh: 错误地；不正确地；荒谬地

senses.title: Wrong because the premise is wrong
senses.definition: in a manner resulting from a false belief rather than from intent
senses.definitionCN: 源于错误信念而非出于故意
senses.example: He was erroneously blamed.
senses.exampleCN: 他受到了错误的指责。
senses.why: The suffix -ly turns the adjective's fault into the way an act is done.
senses.whyCN: 副词词尾把形容词的缺陷变成动作的方式。

senses.title: Incorrect in record or statement
senses.definition: used when a document, figure or report gives what is not true
senses.definitionCN: 指文件、数字或报道给出失实内容
senses.example: The ledger was erroneously closed.
senses.exampleCN: 账簿被误关闭了。
senses.why: Legal and clerical prose reach for it to soften blame on a person.
senses.whyCN: 法律与文书用它来淡化对个人的追责。

senses.title: Ridiculously mistaken
senses.definition: a rhetorical use stressing how far from sense the mistake is
senses.definitionCN: 修辞用法，强调错误离常识之远
senses.example: They erroneously trusted the rumour.
senses.exampleCN: 他们竟然误信了那条谣言。
senses.why: Commentary borrows the adverb to signal an error beyond excuse.
senses.whyCN: 评论借用该副词来标记不可原谅之错。

intro.en: Erroneously descends from Latin erroneus, going astray, from errare to wander, plus -ous, then -ly.
intro.cn: erroneously 源自拉丁语 erroneus「走偏的」，出自 errare「游荡」加 -ous，再添副词词尾 -ly。

items.en: Errare means to wander or stray.
items.cn: errare 意为游荡或偏离。

items.en: Erroneus describes an opinion that has gone astray.
items.cn: erroneus 形容走偏的见解。

items.en: The suffix -osus supplies the quality ending.
items.cn: 后缀 -osus 提供表性质的词尾。

items.en: English takes erroneous with a scholarly air.
items.cn: 十五世纪英语以书面色彩摄入 erroneous。

items.en: Religious dispute loads it with blame for false doctrine.
items.cn: 十七世纪宗教论争把它压上异端之责。

items.en: Editing and law use it to mark a simple inaccuracy.
items.cn: 现代编校与法律用它标示单纯失实。

note.en: Group one holds the error family and its adverbs; group two holds other adverbs of doing something wrong.
note.cn: 第一组是 error 词族及其副词；第二组是其他表做错方式的副词。

entries.definition: Describes the belief or statement itself, not the act.
entries.definitionCN: 形容信念或陈述本身，而非动作。

entries.definition: Signals no regular pattern, not wrongness of content.
entries.definitionCN: 提示没有规律，而非内容有误。

entries.definition: Marks a slip in precision, milder than erroneously.
entries.definitionCN: 标示精度上的偏差，语气弱于 erroneously。

entries.definition: The plain household word for the same idea.
entries.definitionCN: 同一意思的日常说法。

entries.definition: The briefest adverb for doing or judging amiss.
entries.definitionCN: 表做错或判错的最简短副词。

entries.definition: Stresses that what was said is not true, sometimes on purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 强调所述不实，有时含故意。

entries.definition: Marks a failure to meet a standard or format.
entries.definitionCN: 标示未达标准或格式。

entries.definition: Points at a broken chain of reasoning rather than a false fact.
entries.definitionCN: 指向断裂的推理链而非虚假事实。

normalIntro.en: Erroneously attacks the premise; incorrectly attacks the form.
normalIntro.cn: erroneously 指向前提有误，incorrectly 指向形式不合。

normal.en: Common before believe, assume, report, credit.
normal.cn: 常置于 believe、assume、report、credit 之前。

normal.en: Formal register; prefer mistakenly in speech.
normal.cn: 语域正式；口语宜用 mistakenly。

normal.en: Passive notices use it to avoid naming a culprit.
normal.cn: 被动通告用它来回避点出责任人。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with arbitrarily, which is about whim.
normal.cn: 不要与 arbitrarily 混淆，后者关乎一时兴起。

normal.en: It carries no blame of intent, only of fact.
normal.cn: 它不指责动机，只指陈事实。

abstract.en: Picture a decimal point moved one place, dragging a column with it.
abstract.cn: 想象小数点移了一格，带着整列数字一起走错。

abstract.en: Imagine a label tied to the wrong suitcase on a carousel.
abstract.cn: 想象行李转盘上标签系错了箱子。

abstract.en: Think of a signature on a form that says the opposite.
abstract.cn: 想想在一份写着相反内容的表格上签下的名字。

examples.en: She was erroneously listed as retired.
examples.cn: 她被误列为已退休。

examples.en: The paper erroneously credits another lab.
examples.cn: 那篇论文误把成果记在另一实验室名下。

examples.en: Few readers notice the figures were erroneously summed.
examples.cn: 鲜有读者注意到这些数字被错误地加总了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一路泥湿」——一路都把泥泞误认作实地，走得步步不对，所以 erroneously 是错误地、失误地；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 errare（游荡、走偏）→ erroneus（走偏的、错误的）＋ -ous（具有……性质的）→ erroneous ＋ 副词词尾 -ly → erroneously，核心义「以偏离正路的方式行事或判断」。

sensesIntro.en: The adverb covers mistakes of premise, faults of record, and a rhetorical stress on absurdity.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个副词涵盖前提之误、记载之失，以及强调荒谬的修辞用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a step taken in good faith on ground that is not where it was marked.
core.cn: 核心意象：在标注有误的地面上凭诚意迈出的一步。

branches.en: A false premise drives the whole act.
branches.cn: 错误前提驱动整个行为。

branches.en: Documents repeat the error without anyone meaning it.
branches.cn: 文件无人有意地复述这一错误。

branches.en: Commentary stresses how far off course the act was.
branches.cn: 评论强调这一步偏航之远。

branches.en: Both treat the mistake as unintentional.
branches.cn: 两者都把错误视为非故意。

branches.en: Both belong to written and public speech.
branches.cn: 两者都属于书面与公开言说。

intro.en: Three endings stack on one stem of straying: -eus, -ous, then -ly.
intro.cn: 三层词尾叠在同一个表偏离的词干上：先是 -eus，再是 -ous，最后是 -ly。

latinIntro.en: Latin errare is to wander, erroneus mistaken, and error a wandering.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 errare 表游荡，erroneus 表错误的，error 表游荡之事。

items.example: Err- is the whole family core.
items.exampleCN: err- 是整个词族的核心。

definition_zh: 保存；保护；节约（资源）；把果子熬成蜜饯
definition_en: to keep something in good condition and prevent it from being damaged, wasted or used up
core_image: 一间恒温恒湿的库房把老纸页锁在里面，门外是不断变化的天气，门内一切不变
scene: 这组词中， Volunteers conserve the fragile manuscripts in a climate-controlled vault.
sceneCN: 这里 conserve 指「妥善保存，使易损物件不继续损坏」（第 1 个义项：把物件维持在稳定状态以免受损）；句意为志愿者把易损手稿放进恒温恒湿的库房保存。图中可辨识物件：恒温柜、平放的纸页、湿度表、白手套。

pos.zh: 保存；保护；节约（资源、能量）
蜜饯；果脯（英式，指加糖熬煮的果酱）

senses.title: Keep an object from further damage
senses.titleCN: 把物件维持在稳定环境以免继续损坏
senses.definition: to keep a fragile object in a stable condition so that it does not decay or break down
senses.definitionCN: 把易损物件维持在稳定条件下，使其不再腐坏或破损
senses.example: Volunteers conserve the fragile manuscripts in a climate-controlled vault.
senses.exampleCN: 志愿者把易损手稿保存在恒温恒湿的库房里。
senses.why: conserve is built from com- 'thoroughly' plus servare 'to keep safe', so the core reading is to keep something safe all round.
senses.whyCN: conserve 由 com-「彻底」加 servare「守住」构成，核心意思就是「把某物整个守住」。

senses.title: Protect a natural resource
senses.titleCN: 保护自然资源，使其能长期存在
senses.definition: to use a natural resource carefully so that it survives for future use
senses.definitionCN: 谨慎使用自然资源，使其能留存到未来
senses.example: Ranchers conserve grassland by rotating their herds.
senses.exampleCN: 牧场主用轮牧的方式保护草地。
senses.why: the environmental sense grew out of the older one: a forest is kept safe by limiting how much is taken from it.
senses.whyCN: 环保义由旧义延伸而来：限制取用量，就是让森林保持安全。

senses.title: Avoid wasting time or effort
senses.titleCN: 节省体力、时间与燃料，不作无谓消耗
senses.definition: to avoid using up energy, time or strength unnecessarily
senses.definitionCN: 避免无谓地消耗体力、时间或力量
senses.example: Runners conserve energy on the climb so they can sprint at the end.
senses.exampleCN: 跑者在爬坡时保存体力，好在最后冲刺。
senses.why: keeping a supply safe and not drawing on it are the same idea seen from two sides, so conserve slid into the sense of saving.
senses.whyCN: 把储备守住与不动用它，是同一件事的两面，因此 conserve 自然引申出「节省」。

senses.title: Cook fruit into a conserve
senses.definition: to cook fruit with sugar so that it keeps for a long time
senses.definitionCN: 把水果与糖一起熬煮，使其能长期存放
senses.example: They conserve plums with honey and a little lemon.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把李子加蜂蜜和少许柠檬熬成蜜饯。
senses.why: from the sixteenth century the word was applied to food kept safe by sugar, since sugar does for fruit what a vault does for paper.
senses.whyCN: 从 16 世纪起，这个词用于靠糖保住的食物：糖对果子做的事，正如库房对纸页做的事。

senses.title: A thick fruit jam
senses.definition: a thick sweet preparation of fruit cooked with sugar
senses.definitionCN: 水果加糖熬成的浓稠甜品
senses.example: A spoonful of apricot conserve went onto the warm bread.
senses.exampleCN: 一勺杏子蜜饯抹在热面包上。
senses.why: the noun is simply the product of the verb, so English uses the same form for the act and for the jar.
senses.whyCN: 名词只是动词的产物，因此英语用同一个词形既指动作也指罐中之物。

senses.title: Hold a quantity constant in physics
senses.titleCN: 物理中保持某个量守恒
senses.definition: to remain constant through a physical process, as mass or charge does
senses.definitionCN: 在物理过程中保持不变，如质量或电荷
senses.example: In an isolated system, charge is conserved through every reaction.
senses.exampleCN: 在孤立系统中，电荷在每一次反应中都守恒。
senses.why: the older sense of keeping something intact was narrowed by physics into the rule that a total does not change.
senses.whyCN: 「保持完整」的旧义被物理学收窄为一条规则：总量不发生变化。

senses.title: Keep a right or condition in force
senses.titleCN: 使某项权利或状态继续有效
senses.definition: to keep a legal right or an arrangement valid rather than letting it lapse
senses.definitionCN: 使法律权利或某种安排继续有效，而非任其失效
senses.example: The clause conserves the tenant's right to renew the lease.
senses.exampleCN: 该条款保留了租客续租的权利。
senses.why: law borrowed the word because a right that is kept safe is a right that is not lost by silence or delay.
senses.whyCN: 法律借用这个词，因为权利被守住就意味着不因沉默或拖延而丧失。

senses.title: Keep the essential character
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：在变形中保住核心特征
senses.definition: to keep the essential character of something even when its outward form changes
senses.definitionCN: 即使外在形式改变，也保住某物的核心特征
senses.example: The arranger conserved the melody while rewriting every harmony.
senses.exampleCN: 编曲者改写了全部和声，却保住了旋律。
senses.why: the abstract sense generalizes the core: what is conserved is no longer a thing but the pattern that makes it what it is.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义把核心一般化：被守住的不再是一件东西，而是使它成为它的那个格局。

intro.en: Conserve comes through Old French from Latin conservare 'to keep safe, maintain', built on com- 'together, thoroughly' and servare 'to keep, watch over'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: conserve 经古法语来自拉丁 conservare「保住、维持」，由 com-「共同、彻底」与 servare「看守、保存」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Servare meant 'to keep, watch over, guard'. Its deeper origin is not established; the link sometimes suggested to servire 'to serve' is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated derivation.
items.cn: servare 意为「看守、保存、守护」。其更深来源未得到证明；有人把它与 servire「服侍」联系起来，那只是假说，并非已证实的派生。

items.en: Com- 'together, thoroughly' plus servare produced conservare 'to keep safe, to maintain, to preserve'.
items.cn: com-「共同、彻底」加 servare 构成 conservare「保住、维持、保存」。

items.en: Old French conserver carried the verb into English in the fourteenth century, first in the sense of keeping health or a condition intact.
items.cn: 古法语 conserver 在 14 世纪把这个动词带入英语，最初指保持健康或某种状态不坏。

items.en: By the sixteenth century conserve was used for fruit cooked with sugar, and the noun for the product followed soon after.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，conserve 已用于指加糖熬煮的水果，指成品的名词义随后出现。

items.en: From the nineteenth century the word was applied to forests, soil and wildlife, and this resource sense now dominates everyday use.
items.cn: 从 19 世纪起，这个词被用于森林、土壤与野生动物，这一资源义如今在日常使用中占主导。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper origin): no exact first citation is recorded for the resource sense, and the pre-Latin origin of servare is unsettled, so any Indo-European form offered for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词源）：资源义没有确切的最早书证；servare 在拉丁语之前的来源亦无定论，凡为其给出的印欧形式均属重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds verbs built on the Latin -serve stock that are constantly confused; group two holds near neighbours with a different shade of keeping.
note.cn: 第一组是同出拉丁 -serve 词干、极易混淆的动词；第二组是语义相近但「保住」的侧重点不同的词。

entries.definition: Built on prae- 'before' plus servare, so it stresses protecting something before harm reaches it; it also names jam and a nature reserve.
entries.definitionCN: 由 prae-「在前」加 servare 构成，强调在损害到来之前先护住；也指果酱与自然保护区。

entries.definition: Re- 'back' plus servare: to hold something back for later use, as in reserve a seat or oil reserves.
entries.definitionCN: re-「向后」加 servare：把某物留到以后用，如预订座位、石油储量。

entries.definition: From de- 'fully' plus servire 'to serve', not servare: to have earned something by service, so it is not a relative of conserve at the root.
entries.definitionCN: 来自 de-「完全」加 servire「服侍」，而非 servare：因服务而应得，因此词根上与 conserve 并非同族。

entries.definition: Ob- 'toward' plus servare: to keep one's eyes on something, hence to watch, notice or obey a rule.
entries.definitionCN: ob-「朝向」加 servare：把目光守在事物上，因此指观察、注意或遵守规则。

entries.definition: A general verb for shielding something from danger; it says nothing about careful use, which conserve adds.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指使某物免受危险，不含「节制使用」的意思，而 conserve 带有这一层。

entries.definition: To keep something in its current working condition, as a road or a machine; conserve is closer to keeping it from loss.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物保持现有的运转状态，如道路或机器；conserve 更偏向使之不致损失。

entries.definition: The common verb for avoiding waste, as in save water; conserve is its formal and technical counterpart.
entries.definitionCN: 指避免浪费的日常动词，如节约用水；conserve 是它正式、技术化的对应词。

entries.definition: To continue to hold something already possessed, such as heat or a right; it does not imply active care.
entries.definitionCN: 指继续保有已拥有之物，如热量或权利；不含主动照料之意。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: com- 'thoroughly' + servare 'keep safe': to keep something safe all round.
normal.cn: com-「彻底」+ servare「守住」：把某物整个护住。

normal.en: The family runs conserve, conservation, conservative, conservationist, conservator, conservancy.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 conserve、conservation、conservative、conservationist、conservator、conservancy。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the resource sense: conserve energy, conserve water, conserve wildlife.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出资源义：节约能源、节约用水、保护野生动物。

normal.en: The same root appears in preserve, reserve and observe, all through Latin servare.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在 preserve、reserve 与 observe 中，都经拉丁 servare。

normal.en: Physics uses the passive form: charge is conserved, energy is conserved.
normal.cn: 物理用被动式：电荷守恒、能量守恒。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed jar that holds summer inside it while winter runs outside.
abstract.cn: 想象一只密封罐，里面装着夏天，外面正跑着冬天。

abstract.en: Picture a bank account nobody draws from, so the balance stays what it was.
abstract.cn: 想象一个没人取钱的账户，余额始终停在原处。

abstract.en: Picture a song rearranged into a new key but still recognizably itself.
abstract.cn: 想象一首歌被改写调性，却仍听得出是原来的歌。

examples.en: The trust conserves the wetland by buying the land around it.
examples.cn: 该信托基金买下周边土地，以保护这片湿地。

examples.en: Turning off unused lights conserves both energy and money.
examples.cn: 关掉不用的灯既省能源也省钱。

examples.en: In every chemical reaction, the total mass is conserved.
examples.cn: 在每一个化学反应中，总质量守恒。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「con（共同）+ serve（服务/看守）」——大家一起守住资源 → 保存、保护、节约

root: 拉丁 conservare「保住、维持」= com-（共同、彻底）+ servare「看守、保存」；servare 更深来源不确定，与 servire「服侍」的联系仅为假说。英语 conserve。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one gesture: something valuable is closed off from decay, and that gesture is then applied to forests, fuel, fruit, physical totals, legal rights and finally to a pattern that survives a rewrite.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：把有价值之物与腐坏隔开，这个动作再依次用于森林、燃料、果子、物理总量、法律权利，最后用于一个经改写仍存活的格局。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stable room holding something precious while the weather outside keeps changing.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间稳定的屋子守住贵重之物，屋外天气不断变化。

branches.en: KEEP-SAFE OBJECT: whether paper or a lease, the point is that nothing is lost.
branches.cn: 守住对象：无论纸页还是租约，要点都是不让它失去。

branches.en: WISE USE: a supply is kept safe by drawing on it slowly.
branches.cn: 善用：慢慢取用，储备才得以安全。

branches.en: SEALED FRUIT: sugar does for fruit what a vault does for paper.
branches.cn: 封住的果子：糖对果子做的事，正如库房对纸页做的事。

branches.en: CONSTANT TOTAL: physics narrows keeping intact to a number that never changes.
branches.cn: 总量不变：物理学把「保持完整」收窄为一个永不改变的数。

branches.en: SURVIVING PATTERN: what is kept is no longer a thing but the shape that makes it itself.
branches.cn: 存活的格局：被守住的不再是实体，而是使它成为它的形态。

intro.en: Conserve is a Latin verb made of a prefix and a root that also build several other English words, so the whole family can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: conserve 是一个由前缀与词根构成的拉丁动词，这两部分还构成若干英语词，因此整个词族可以按语素逐个读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin servare gives conserve, preserve, reserve, observe and servitude; com- adds the sense of doing something thoroughly or together.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 servare 衍生 conserve、preserve、reserve、observe 与 servitude；com- 增添「彻底、共同」的意思。

items.example: The prefix binds the action into a single whole.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把动作收束为一个整体。

items.example: The root carries the idea of keeping watch.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根带着「看守」的意思。

items.meaning: the act or result of keeping safe
tending to keep things as they are
items.meaningCN: 倾向维持原状的；保守的
items.example: She took a conservative estimate of the cost.
items.exampleCN: 她对成本做了保守的估计。

items.meaning: a person who works to protect nature
items.example: The conservationist mapped the last old-growth stands.
items.exampleCN: 这位自然保护者标出了最后几片原始林。

items.meaning: a person who repairs and maintains objects
items.example: The conservator cleaned the painting layer by layer.
items.exampleCN: 修复师一层层地清理这幅画。

items.meaning: an organization or area that manages protection
items.meaningCN: 保护管理机构或保护区
items.example: The river conservancy patrols the banks.
items.exampleCN: 河流保护机构巡护两岸。

items.example: Only a conservable portion of the archive survived.
items.exampleCN: 档案中只有可保存的一部分留了下来。

definition_zh: 淡水；淡水的；淡水生的；内陆水域的；（口语）无经验的水手
definition_en: water that is not salty, found in rivers, lakes and streams; living in or relating to such water
core_image: 山间溪流清澈见底，绕过石头向下流去，远处是咸涩的海湾
scene: 山间的溪流清澈见底，一路向下，与海湾的咸水完全不同。 The mountain stream runs clear, a freshwater source far above the salty bay.
sceneCN: 这里 freshwater 指「不咸的淡水」（第 1 个义项：河流湖泊中的非咸水水体）；句意：山间溪流清澈，是一处远高于咸水海湾的淡水源。图中可辨识物件：清浅溪流、溪石、山坡、远处的海湾。

pos.zh: 淡水（河流、湖泊中的非咸水）
淡水的；淡水生的；内陆水域的

senses.title: Water that is not salty
senses.definition: water with very little dissolved salt, as found in rivers, lakes, ponds and most streams
senses.definitionCN: 溶解盐分极少的水，见于河流、湖泊、池塘与多数溪流
senses.example: The mountain stream runs clear, a freshwater source far above the salty bay.
senses.exampleCN: 山间溪流清澈，是一处远高于咸水海湾的淡水源。
senses.why: the compound simply names water that is fresh in the old sense 'not salt', so the defining contrast is salinity, not temperature or cleanliness.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词只是命名「fresh」旧义「不咸」的水，界定性对照是盐度，而非温度或洁净程度。

senses.title: Living in non-salty water
senses.titleCN: 生活在淡水中的（形容词）
senses.definition: describing organisms that live in rivers and lakes rather than in the sea
senses.definitionCN: 描述生活在河流湖泊而非海中的生物
senses.example: Freshwater snails graze the algae on the pond stones.
senses.exampleCN: 淡水螺啃食池石上的藻类。
senses.why: the noun is used attributively before organism names, turning a water type into a habitat label.
senses.whyCN: 名词直接置于生物名称前作定语，把一种水型变成生境标签。

senses.title: Inland water systems as a whole
senses.definition: relating to the connected rivers, lakes, wetlands and groundwater of the land, as opposed to the sea
senses.definitionCN: 与陆地上相连的河流、湖泊、湿地和地下水有关，与海洋相对
senses.example: Freshwater systems store less water than oceans but support far more species per litre.
senses.exampleCN: 淡水系统储水远少于海洋，但每升水支持的物种却多得多。
senses.why: hydrology and ecology use the adjective for the whole inland network, because its parts exchange water and organisms.
senses.whyCN: 水文学与生态学用这个形容词指整个内陆网络，因为其各部分交换水与生物。

senses.title: Fresh water as a resource
senses.definition: the drinkable or irrigation water that people extract from rivers, lakes and aquifers
senses.definitionCN: 人们从河流、湖泊与含水层取用的饮用水或灌溉水
senses.example: The city's freshwater supply comes from a single upland reservoir.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市的淡水供应来自一座高地水库。
senses.why: policy and engineering treat the same water as a stock to be allocated, so the word shifts from medium to commodity.
senses.whyCN: 政策与工程把同一种水当作可分配的存量，词义因此从介质转为商品。

senses.title: Freshwater fishing and farming
senses.definition: relating to the catching or farming of fish and other organisms in rivers, lakes and ponds
senses.definitionCN: 与在河流、湖泊、池塘中捕捞或养殖鱼类及其它生物有关
senses.example: Freshwater aquaculture now exceeds capture fishing in several provinces.
senses.exampleCN: 在若干省份，淡水养殖已超过捕捞渔业。
senses.why: the resource sense narrows to an industry, and the compound becomes an ordinary adjective in fisheries economics.
senses.whyCN: 资源义收窄为一种产业，这个复合词便成为渔业经济中的普通形容词。

senses.title: A freshwater sailor: an inexperienced one
senses.titleCN: 习语：没出过海的新手水手
senses.definition: informal, a sailor who has never been to sea, or more generally a person with no experience of a place
senses.definitionCN: 口语中指从未出过海的水手，更泛指对某地毫无经验的人
senses.example: The crew soon saw that the new hand was a freshwater sailor.
senses.exampleCN: 船员们很快看出这个新手是个没出过海的人。
senses.why: fresh water is the opposite of the sailor's element, so calling a sailor freshwater is a mild insult about inexperience.
senses.whyCN: 淡水是水手所处元素的反面，因此把水手称作 freshwater 是对其缺乏经验的轻度讥讽。

senses.title: Freshwater ecology as a category
senses.titleCN: 淡水生态学中的分类范畴
senses.definition: used in ecology and conservation to classify studies and species by low-salinity habitat
senses.definitionCN: 生态学与保护学中按低盐度生境对研究与物种进行分类
senses.example: The report separates freshwater from marine species in its extinction estimates.
senses.exampleCN: 报告在灭绝估计中把淡水物种与海洋物种分开统计。
senses.why: conservation planning needs a category between land and sea, and freshwater fills that gap as a technical label.
senses.whyCN: 保护规划需要陆与海之间的类别，freshwater 作为技术标签正好填补这一空档。

senses.title: The two-word open form
senses.titleCN: 分写形式 fresh water 的用法
senses.definition: the open spelling fresh water, used when the phrase is a plain noun and the salt contrast is being stated directly
senses.definitionCN: 分写形式 fresh water，用于普通名词短语、并直接陈述「不咸」这一对照时
senses.example: The tide pushed fresh water far up the channel after the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨后，潮水把淡水推到了河道的很上游。
senses.why: English often keeps a compound open while it still feels like a phrase; the closed form freshwater has become the technical adjective.
senses.whyCN: 当一个复合词仍像短语时，英语常保持分写；闭合形式 freshwater 则成了技术形容词。

intro.en: Freshwater is an English compound of fresh, in its old sense 'not salt', and water. The adjective is Germanic, while the modern sense 'new, lively' was reinforced by Old French fres.
intro.cn: freshwater 是英语复合词，由 fresh（旧义「不咸」）与 water 构成。fresh 属日耳曼语，而现代「新鲜、有活力」义受古法语 fres 影响而加强。

items.en: Old English fersc meant 'not salt' and was used of water long before it meant 'new'; the salt contrast is the oldest sense.
items.cn: 古英语 fersc 意为「不咸」，早在表示「新」之前就用于水；不咸这一对照是最古老的义项。

items.en: The adjective goes back to a Germanic form such as *friskaz, whose own pre-Germanic origin is reconstructed rather than recorded.
items.cn: 该形容词可追溯到 *friskaz 之类的日耳曼语形式，其日耳曼语之前的来源属重构而非有记录。

items.en: Old French fres 'fresh, new, eager' reinforced the newer sense of English fresh, which is why the word now means both 'not salt' and 'new'.
items.cn: 古法语 fres「新鲜、新、急切」加强了英语 fresh 较新的义项，因此这个词如今既指「不咸」也指「新」。

items.en: Freshwater appears from the late Middle English period as a compound naming inland, drinkable water, and later as an adjective before organism names.
items.cn: freshwater 自中古英语晚期出现，作为复合词指内陆可饮之水，后来又用作生物名称前的形容词。

items.en: In modern ecology and fisheries the closed form freshwater became a technical label opposed to marine and terrestrial.
items.cn: 在现代生态学与渔业中，闭合形式 freshwater 成为与 marine、terrestrial 相对的技术标签。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin only): the pre-Germanic shape of fresh is a reconstruction, and the earliest compound citation is dated only approximately.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅更深词源）：fresh 的日耳曼语之前形态属重构，复合词最早书证的年代也只能大致确定。

note.en: Group one separates the closed compound from its open spelling and from three words built on the same fresh root; group two contrasts it with neighbouring water categories.
note.cn: 第一组区分闭合复合词与分写形式，并辨明三个同出 fresh 词根的词；第二组对照相邻的水类词语。

entries.definition: The two-word phrase for non-salty water; the closed form freshwater is preferred when the word works as a technical adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 指不咸之水的两词短语；当该词作技术形容词时，更常用闭合形式 freshwater。

entries.definition: A sudden rise of water in a stream, especially from rain or melting snow; it shares fresh but names a flood event.
entries.definitionCN: 溪流因降雨或融雪突然涨水；与 fresh 同源，但指一次洪水事件。

entries.definition: To make someone or something feel new again; re- 'again' plus fresh, so it is about renewal, not salinity.
entries.definitionCN: 使某人或某物重新恢复精神；由 re-「再」加 fresh 构成，讲的是更新而非盐度。

entries.definition: A first-year student; fresh here means 'new', so the compound has nothing to do with water.
entries.definitionCN: 一年级新生；此处 fresh 意为「新」，因此该复合词与水无关。

entries.definition: Located away from the coast; it names position, while freshwater names salinity.
entries.definitionCN: 位于远离海岸之处；它命名位置，而 freshwater 命名盐度。

entries.definition: Relating to lakes; it is a narrower technical term inside the freshwater category.
entries.definitionCN: 与湖泊有关的；是淡水范畴内更窄的专门术语。

entries.definition: Relating to rivers and their banks; another narrow member of the freshwater family.
entries.definitionCN: 与河流及其河岸有关的；淡水词族中另一个较窄的成员。

entries.definition: Water containing much dissolved salt; it is the exact antonym that defines freshwater by contrast.
entries.definitionCN: 含大量溶解盐的水；它正是通过对照界定 freshwater 的反义词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real fresh and water roots, real compounds and real collocations.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的 fresh 与 water 词根、真实复合词与真实搭配。

normal.en: Fresh in freshwater is the old sense 'not salt', not the modern sense 'newly picked'.
normal.cn: freshwater 中的 fresh 是旧义「不咸」，不是现代「刚采摘的」之义。

normal.en: Freshwater fish, freshwater lake and freshwater marsh are the standard field-guide collocations.
normal.cn: freshwater fish、freshwater lake、freshwater marsh 是野外图鉴的标准搭配。

normal.en: The open form fresh water appears when the phrase is a plain noun phrase.
normal.cn: 当它只是普通名词短语时，用分写形式 fresh water。

normal.en: Freshwater sailor is a fixed idiom for someone who has never been to sea.
normal.cn: freshwater sailor 是固定习语，指从未出过海的人。

normal.en: Ecology pairs freshwater with marine and terrestrial as the three basic habitat labels.
normal.cn: 生态学把 freshwater 与 marine、terrestrial 并列为三个基本生境标签。

abstract.en: Picture a glass of clear water carried down from a mountain, never having touched the sea.
abstract.cn: 想象一杯从山上带下的清水，从未碰过海水。

abstract.en: Picture a sailor who knows every rope but has never seen a wave larger than a bathtub's.
abstract.cn: 想象一个熟悉每根绳索、却没见过比浴缸更大的浪的水手。

abstract.en: Picture a map where a blue vein runs inland and stops just before the coast.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，一条蓝色细流伸向内陆，在海岸前止住。

examples.en: Freshwater wetlands filter pollutants before they reach the river.
examples.cn: 淡水湿地在污染物进入河流之前将其过滤。

examples.en: The lake holds the largest freshwater reserve in the region.
examples.cn: 这座湖拥有该地区最大的淡水储量。

examples.en: Only a freshwater sailor would moor there without checking the tide.
examples.cn: 只有没出过海的新手才会不查潮汐就把船停在那里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「fresh（不咸的、新鲜的）+ water（水）」——不咸的水就是淡水

root: 英语复合词：fresh（古英语 fersc「不咸」，后受古法语 fres「新」影响）+ water（古英语 wæter「水」）；无拉丁语来源，latinEntries 留空。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses start from a simple chemical fact, low salinity, and then spread: water itself, the organisms in it, the inland network, the resource, the fishery, the idiom about inexperienced sailors, the ecological category, and finally the open two-word spelling.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一条简单的化学事实「低盐度」出发，随后铺开：水本身、其中的生物、内陆水网、资源、渔业、关于新手水手的习语、生态分类，最后是分写的两词形式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: clear water that has never met the sea.
core.cn: 核心意象：从未与海相遇的清甜之水。

branches.en: THE WATER ITSELF: the noun and its open spelling both name low-salinity water.
branches.cn: 水本身：名词与分写形式都指低盐度的水。

branches.en: LIFE AND SYSTEMS: organisms and the connected inland network are labelled by the medium.
branches.cn: 生命与系统：生物与相连的内陆水网按介质被命名。

branches.en: WATER AS STOCK: supply and aquaculture treat fresh water as a resource and an industry.
branches.cn: 水作为存量：供水与养殖把淡水当作资源与产业。

branches.en: INEXPERIENCE: the landlubber idiom borrows the sailor's opposite element as an insult.
branches.cn: 缺乏经验：陆上人的习语借用与水手相反的元素作讥讽。

branches.en: CLASSIFICATION: ecology uses the word as one of three basic habitat labels.
branches.cn: 分类：生态学把它用作三个基本生境标签之一。

intro.en: Freshwater is a native English compound, not a Latin derivative. Its parts are the adjective fresh and the noun water, and the same parts build freshet, refresh, freshness and freshwater compounds.
intro.cn: freshwater 是英语本族复合词，并非拉丁派生词。其构件是形容词 fresh 与名词 water，同样的构件还构成 freshet、refresh、freshness 以及各类 freshwater 复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source. Latin aqua dulcis 'sweet water' translates the idea but is not a cognate, so latinEntries is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语来源。拉丁 aqua dulcis「甜水」只是语义对应，并非同源，因此 latinEntries 留空。

definition_zh: 计算的；与计算有关的；借助计算机完成的；计算代价与复杂度的；计算模型与仿真的；以计算方法命名的学科的；数值误差与计算精度的；认知科学中「心智即计算」的
definition_en: relating to calculation, or describing work that is carried out by methods of calculation and often by machines
core_image: 一张网格纸被切成无数小格，每一格同时被算过一遍
scene: 实验室的墙上贴着一张被切成许多小方格的网格纸，每一格都标着一个步骤。 Their computational approach splits the image into small patches and scores each one.
sceneCN: 这里 computational 指「属于计算模型与仿真方法的」（第 4 个义项：以计算模型处理问题）；句意：他们的计算式方法把图像切成小块，再逐块打分。图中可辨识物件：网格纸、小方格、步骤标号、屏幕、放大镜。

pos.zh: 计算的；与计算有关的

derivatives.zh: 在计算方面；从计算角度

senses.title: Belonging to calculation in general
senses.definition: relating to calculation itself, whether done by hand, by formula or by machine
senses.definitionCN: 与计算本身有关，不论计算由手工、公式还是机器完成
senses.example: The paper keeps the computational part separate from the field study.
senses.exampleCN: 论文把计算部分与实地研究分开处理。
senses.why: The suffix -al simply says 'of or belonging to', so the adjective can attach to calculation without naming any device.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -al 只表示「属于」，因此这个形容词可以挂在计算上，而不提任何装置。

senses.title: Done with a machine rather than by hand
senses.definition: carried out by machine methods instead of manual or purely theoretical work
senses.definitionCN: 以机器方法而非手工或纯理论方式完成的
senses.example: A computational shortcut saved the team weeks of laboratory work.
senses.exampleCN: 一条计算捷径为团队省下了数周的实验室工作。
senses.why: Once most long calculations moved to machines, the adjective became a practical label for the machine route.
senses.whyCN: 当长串计算大多转到机器上，这个形容词就成了机器路线的实用标签。

senses.title: The price of running an algorithm
senses.titleCN: 运行算法要付出的代价
senses.definition: the time, memory or number of steps that an algorithm costs as its input grows
senses.definitionCN: 算法随输入增大而耗费的时间、内存或步骤数
senses.example: The team measured the computational cost before scaling up.
senses.exampleCN: 团队在扩大规模之前先测量了计算成本。
senses.why: If a method is to be judged practical, its demands need a name, and that name is the adjective attached to cost or complexity.
senses.whyCN: 要判断一种方法是否实用，就得给它的开销一个名字，这名字就是挂在成本或复杂度前的这个形容词。

senses.title: Models and simulation
senses.definition: describing a model or simulation that represents a system by rules a machine can run
senses.definitionCN: 形容用机器可执行的规则来表征某个系统的模型或仿真
senses.example: A computational model of the climate ran a century in an afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 一个气候计算模型在一个下午里跑完了一百年。
senses.why: A model becomes computational when its behaviour is produced by step-by-step calculation rather than by physical resemblance.
senses.whyCN: 当一个模型的行为由逐步计算产生、而非靠实物相似，它就是计算模型。

senses.title: A discipline named by its method
senses.definition: used in the names of fields, such as computational linguistics or computational biology, that apply calculation to another subject
senses.definitionCN: 用于学科名称，如计算语言学或计算生物学，表示把计算应用到另一门学问
senses.example: The field of computational linguistics borrows tools from statistics and grammar.
senses.exampleCN: 计算语言学借用了统计与语法的工具。
senses.why: When a field is defined by its method rather than its subject, the adjective moves in front of the subject name and stays there.
senses.whyCN: 当一门学问靠方法而非题材定义，这个形容词就移到题材名前面并固定下来。

senses.title: Thinking in steps a machine could follow
senses.titleCN: 按机器能照做的步骤思考
senses.definition: describing the kind of problem solving that breaks a task into ordered steps, decomposition and abstraction
senses.definitionCN: 形容把任务拆成有序步骤、分解与抽象的问题解决方式
senses.example: Schools now teach computational thinking before any programming language.
senses.exampleCN: 学校现在先教计算思维，再教任何编程语言。
senses.why: The adjective reaches beyond machinery to a habit of mind, because the same ordered steps can be taught without a device.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词越出机器，指向一种思维习惯，因为同一套有序步骤不用设备也能教。

senses.title: Error and precision in numbers
senses.definition: relating to the rounding, truncation and instability that arise when calculation is done with finite precision
senses.definitionCN: 与有限精度计算中出现的舍入、截断与不稳定性有关
senses.example: Each extra step added a computational error to the total.
senses.exampleCN: 每多一步，总数里就多一份计算误差。
senses.why: Machines work with limited digits, so the adjective also marks the flaws that calculation introduces into an answer.
senses.whyCN: 机器只有有限的位数，因此这个形容词也标记计算给答案引入的缺陷。

senses.title: The mind described as calculation
senses.definition: in cognitive science, holding that mental processes are operations on representations, in the manner of a calculation
senses.definitionCN: 在认知科学中主张心理过程是对表征的运算，其方式如同计算
senses.example: Some psychologists defend a computational view of memory.
senses.exampleCN: 一些心理学家为记忆的计算观辩护。
senses.why: If the mind performs operations on symbols, then every mental theory built on that picture can carry the adjective.
senses.whyCN: 如果心灵对符号执行运算，那么建立在这幅图景上的每一种心智理论都能带这个形容词。

intro.en: Computational is computation plus the adjective suffix -al, from Latin -alis. Computation descends from Latin computatio, a noun of action from computare 'to reckon together'. The adjective became common only in the twentieth century, with the growth of numerical methods and machine calculation. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: computational 由 computation 加形容词后缀 -al 构成，-al 出自拉丁 -alis。computation 出自拉丁 computatio，是 computare「一起核算」的动作名词。这个形容词到二十世纪才随数值方法与机器计算的兴起而通行。年代均为约数。

items.en: Putare 'to reckon, think' is the root; repute, dispute and impute share it.
items.cn: putare「核算、思考」是词根；repute、dispute 与 impute 共用它。

items.en: Com- 'together' plus putare made computare, 'to reckon together', the verb behind the whole family.
items.cn: com-「一起」加 putare 构成 computare「合起来核算」，是整个词族背后的动词。

items.en: Computatio was the action noun 'a reckoning', formed with -io from the same verb.
items.cn: computatio 是动作名词「核算」，由同一动词加 -io 构成。

items.en: -alis was the ordinary Latin suffix for 'belonging to', and it becomes -al in English adjectives such as national and natural.
items.cn: -alis 是拉丁语里表示「属于」的常用后缀，在英语形容词里变成 -al，如 national 与 natural。

items.en: English took computation through French in the Middle Ages, at first for any reckoning or account.
items.cn: 英语在中世纪经法语引入 computation，最初泛指任何核算或账目。

items.en: Computational spread with numerical analysis and machine calculation, then into field names; first citation uncertain: the earliest English use of the adjective is not securely dated.
items.cn: computational 随数值分析与机器计算传播，后来又进入学科名；首见年代不确定：这个形容词最早的英语用例年代没有可靠定论。

note.en: Group one is the compute family: the noun, the device, the verb and the possibility all look alike but play different roles. Group two holds adjectives that describe how a result was obtained.
note.cn: 第一组是 compute 词族：名词、设备、动词与可能性外形相似，却各扮不同角色。第二组是描述结果如何获得的形容词。

entries.definition: A single calculation or its result, countable when it means one run and uncountable as a process.
entries.definitionCN: 一次计算或其结果；指一次运行时可数，指过程时不可数。

entries.definition: The countable machine; the adjective never points at a machine directly.
entries.definitionCN: 可数的机器；这个形容词从不直接指向某台机器。

entries.definition: To carry out a calculation; the adjective is the description built on the noun, not on the verb.
entries.definitionCN: 执行计算；这个形容词是建立在名词而非动词上的描述。

entries.definition: Able to be calculated in principle; it judges a problem, while computational describes a method.
entries.definitionCN: 原则上可被算出；它判断问题，而 computational 描述方法。

entries.definition: Carried out by approximating with numbers, often in contrast to an exact symbolic solution.
entries.definitionCN: 以数值近似来完成，常与精确的符号解相对。

entries.definition: Defined by a step-by-step procedure, whether or not a machine runs it.
entries.definitionCN: 由逐步程序来定义，不论是否由机器执行。

entries.definition: Belonging to mathematics at large, of which calculation is only one part.
entries.definitionCN: 属于整个数学，计算只是其中一部分。

entries.definition: Produced as an imitation of a real system; it describes the output rather than the calculating method.
entries.definitionCN: 作为真实系统的模仿产物；描述输出而非计算方法。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the -al adjective, the cost and complexity of algorithms, and the field names built on the word.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：-al 形容词、算法的时间与复杂度代价，以及用这个词构造的学科名。

normal.en: Computation plus -al: of or belonging to calculation.
normal.cn: computation 加 -al：属于计算的。

normal.en: It describes the method, never the machine itself.
normal.cn: 它描述方法，从不直接描述机器本身。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: computational model, computational cost, computational linguistics.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：计算模型、计算成本、计算语言学。

normal.en: The adverb form is computationally, as in computationally cheap.
normal.cn: 副词形式是 computationally，如「计算上开销小」。

normal.en: Limit states are more and most computational, not -er and -est.
normal.cn: 比较级与最高级用 more 与 most，不用 -er 与 -est。

abstract.en: Picture a sheet of graph paper cut into a thousand squares, each worked through at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一张方格纸被切成一千格，每一格同时被算一遍。

abstract.en: Picture a stopwatch running beside an algorithm as the input doubles.
abstract.cn: 想象输入翻倍时，一只秒表在算法旁边计时。

abstract.en: Picture a mind drawn as arrows moving between small labelled boxes.
abstract.cn: 想象把心灵画成在许多带标签的小方框之间移动的箭头。

examples.en: The two approaches differ in their computational demands, not in their aims.
examples.cn: 两种路径的差别在计算需求上，而不在目标上。

examples.en: A computational model can fail for reasons that no experiment would reveal.
examples.cn: 计算模型可能因为实验无法揭示的原因而失败。

examples.en: Her argument turns on a computational account of how sentences are parsed.
examples.cn: 她的论证关键在于一套关于句子如何被解析的计算解释。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「comput（算）+ ation（行为）+ al（的）」——属于计算那一套的：计算的、计算式的

root: computation + -al；computation 出自拉丁 computatio「核算」，computatio 又出自 computare「一起核算」= com-「一起」+ putare「核算」。同根词有 compute、computer、computable、computationally。形容词义在二十世纪随数值方法与机器计算通行。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one adjective: belonging to calculation, done by machine, the cost of an algorithm, a model that runs, a field named by its method, an ordered habit of thought, the error of finite precision and the mind treated as calculation.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一个形容词：属于计算、由机器完成、算法的代价、能跑起来的模型、以方法命名的学科、有序的思维习惯、有限精度带来的误差，以及被当成计算的心灵。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the quality of being produced by step-by-step calculation rather than by direct observation.
core.cn: 核心意象：由逐步计算产生、而非由直接观察得来的那种性质。

branches.en: FROM BELONGING TO DOING: the general 'of calculation' sense narrows into 'done by machine' once machines take over the work.
branches.cn: 从归属到执行：泛泛的「属于计算」在机器接手后收窄为「由机器完成」。

branches.en: THE PRICE TAG: every method has a cost in time and memory, and the adjective names that cost.
branches.cn: 代价标签：每种方法都有时间与内存上的开销，这个形容词就给这份开销命名。

branches.en: THE MODEL THAT RUNS: a representation becomes computational when rules, not resemblance, produce its behaviour.
branches.cn: 会跑的模型：当行为由规则而非相似性产生，一个表征就成了计算模型。

branches.en: METHOD INTO NAME: the adjective prefixes whole disciplines, and then hardens into a way of thinking taught on its own.
branches.cn: 方法变成名称：这个形容词加到整门学科前面，随后凝固成一种可单独教授的思维方式。

branches.en: FLAW AND THEORY: finite digits leave error in the answer, while the same picture of stepwise operations becomes a theory of mind.
branches.cn: 缺陷与理论：有限的位数给答案留下误差，而同一幅逐步运算的图景又成了心智理论。

intro.en: Computational stacks a Latin root, a Latin action-noun ending and a Latin adjective ending; each layer is productive in English.
intro.cn: computational 叠了一个拉丁词根、一个拉丁动作名词词尾与一个拉丁形容词词尾，每一层在英语里都能产词。

latinIntro.en: Putare 'to reckon' yields computare and then computatio; -alis 'belonging to' gives English -al, which turns the noun into an adjective.
latinIntro.cn: putare「核算」生出 computare，再出 computatio；-alis「属于」给出英语 -al，把名词变成形容词。

items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把数字聚成一个总和。

items.example: Counting and judging grow from one root.
items.exampleCN: 计数与判断从同一个词根长出。

items.example: The verb supplies the whole English family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词供给整个英语词族。

items.example: The Latin noun is the base of computation.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词是 computation 的基础。

items.meaning: relating to; of the kind of
items.example: The suffix turns a noun into an adjective of relation.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把名词变成表示关系的形容词。

items.example: The noun is the base of the adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是形容词的基础。

items.example: The model is computational rather than physical.
items.exampleCN: 这个模型是计算的，而非实物的。
这种方法在计算上很昂贵。

items.example: The term computationality is rare in ordinary use.
items.exampleCN: computationality 在日常使用中很罕见。

items.example: Machines compute far faster than people.

definition_zh: 天使般的；圣洁的；善良可爱的
definition_en: resembling or befitting an angel, especially in beauty, purity, or kindness
core_image: 孩子熟睡时圣洁的侧脸：干净得像不属于人间
scene: 婴儿在摇篮里安静地睡着。 The sleeping baby had an angelic smile on her face.
sceneCN: 这里 angelic 是「天使般的」（第 1 个义项：如天使般纯洁美好）；句意为：熟睡的婴儿脸上带着天使般的微笑。

pos.zh: 天使般的；圣洁的

derivatives.zh: angel + -hood，义为「天使身份；天使般的状态」

senses.title: Resembling an angel in beauty or purity
senses.definition: having the beauty or purity associated with angels
senses.definitionCN: 具有与天使相联的美貌或纯洁
senses.example: She had an angelic face that painters loved.
senses.exampleCN: 她有一张画家们都喜爱的天使般的面孔。
senses.why: The angel is the picture of perfect purity, so faces and smiles that look heavenly take its name.
senses.whyCN: 天使是纯洁的完美图景，故圣洁美好的面容与微笑借其得名。

senses.title: Kind and good-natured
senses.definition: showing great kindness or goodness of character
senses.definitionCN: 表现出极大的善良或品行上的美好
senses.example: He was angelic to strangers, always ready to help.
senses.exampleCN: 他对陌生人极为友善，总是乐于相助。
senses.why: Angels are messengers of goodwill, so gentle people are said to share their nature.
senses.whyCN: 天使是善意的信使，因此温柔的人被说成具有天使般的本性。

senses.title: Relating to actual angels
senses.definition: belonging to or connected with angels as spiritual beings
senses.definitionCN: 属于天使或与作为灵性存在的天使相关
senses.example: Medieval art devoted whole pages to angelic hierarchies.
senses.exampleCN: 中世纪艺术用整页篇幅描绘天使的等级体系。
senses.why: Before metaphor, the adjective simply pointed at angels themselves.
senses.whyCN: 在比喻用法之前，这个形容词本就直指天使本身。

senses.title: Heavenly in sound
senses.definition: used of voices or music that sound pure and heavenly
senses.definitionCN: 形容声音或音乐纯净如天籁
senses.example: An angelic choir filled the cathedral with song.
senses.exampleCN: 天使般的合唱让大教堂充满歌声。
senses.why: Heaven is imagined as perfect music, so the purest voices borrow its sound.
senses.whyCN: 天堂被想象为完美的音乐，因此最纯净的嗓音借用其声。

senses.title: Sweetly innocent, sometimes deceptively so
senses.titleCN: 天真无邪的（有时貌似如此）
senses.definition: looking innocent or sweet, sometimes while hiding the opposite
senses.definitionCN: 看似天真甜美，有时却藏有反的一面
senses.example: With angelic innocence he asked who had broken the vase.
senses.exampleCN: 他一脸天真无邪地问是谁打碎了花瓶。
senses.why: The halo image can be worn like a mask, so the word gains an ironic edge.
senses.whyCN: 光环可以被当作面具佩戴，这个词因此带上反讽色彩。

senses.title: Extraordinarily patient
senses.definition: showing almost superhuman patience
senses.definitionCN: 表现出近乎超人的耐心
senses.example: She showed angelic patience with the noisy children.
senses.exampleCN: 她对吵闹的孩子表现出天使般的耐心。
senses.why: Angels never lose their temper, so limitless patience is called theirs.
senses.whyCN: 天使从不发怒，所以无限的耐心被称为天使的耐心。

senses.title: Devotional or spiritual in tone
senses.definition: carrying a spiritual or sacred atmosphere
senses.definitionCN: 带有灵性或神圣的氛围
senses.example: The composer wrote an angelic motet for the feast.
senses.exampleCN: 作曲家为节庆谱写了一首圣洁的经文歌。
senses.why: Anything touching the heavenly realm takes on the adjective of its messengers.
senses.whyCN: 一切触及天国领域之物都带上其信使的形容词。

senses.title: Angelically good behavior in children
senses.definition: used of children who behave perfectly well
senses.definitionCN: 形容表现得无可挑剔的孩童
senses.example: The twins were angelic all through the ceremony.
senses.exampleCN: 双胞胎在整个仪式上都很乖巧。
senses.why: The contrast between angelic looks and childish mischief makes the word a favorite, and slightly wry, praise.
senses.whyCN: 天使外貌与孩童顽皮的反差使这个词成为略带调侃的赞美。

intro.en: Angelic travels from a Greek word for messenger through Latin and French to become English's adjective for the heaven-sent.
intro.cn: angelic 从一个希腊语「信使」词出发，经拉丁语与法语，成为英语中形容天国使者的形容词。

items.en: The root *her- meant to move or fit together, generally reconstructed as the source of Greek angelos.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧词根 *her-（移动、配合）是希腊语 angelos 的来源，属重构形式。

items.en: Angelos meant messenger; in the Greek Bible it named divine messengers from God.
items.cn: 希腊语 angelos 意为「信使」；在希腊文圣经中特指上帝派来的使者。

items.en: Latin borrowed the word as angelus, keeping both the plain and the religious senses.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入为 angelus，同时保留了普通义与宗教义。

items.en: Old French received angele, later ange, and built angelique from the Latin form.
items.cn: 古法语承接为 angele（后作 ange），并从拉丁词形派生出 angelique。

items.en: English took angel from French and formed angelic from the Latin adjective in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 英语从法语借得 angel，十六世纪又依拉丁形容词形造出 angelic。

note.en: Grouped by the shared angel- root and by nearby words of heavenly goodness.
note.cn: 按共享的 angel- 词根与「神圣美好」的近义词分组。

entries.definition: relating to the Church of England
entries.definitionCN: 英国国教的，与 angelic 拼写相近但词源无关（出自拉丁 Anglicanus）

entries.definition: an angel of the highest rank
entries.definitionCN: 大天使，共享 angel- 词根

entries.definition: relating to the gospel, from Greek for good news
entries.definitionCN: 福音派的，同出希腊语「信使、消息」词根

entries.definition: relating to seraphim; blissfully pure
entries.definitionCN: 炽天使般的；极度纯洁的，与 angelic 义场相同

entries.definition: of heaven; wonderfully beautiful
entries.definitionCN: 天国的；极美的，日常近义表达

entries.definition: like a cherub, sweetly innocent in appearance
entries.definitionCN: 小天使般的；天真甜美的，多形容孩童面容

normalIntro.en: These hooks rest on the real Greek root angelos, messenger.
normalIntro.cn: 以下记忆钩子基于真实的希腊词根 angelos（信使）。

normal.en: angelos = Greek messenger; an angel is heaven's messenger, angelic describes that nature.
normal.cn: angelos 是希腊语「信使」；天使是天国的信使，angelic 形容其属性。

normal.en: Family: angel → angelic → angelically, one root growing wings.
normal.cn: 词族：angel → angelic → angelically，一个词根长出翅膀。

normal.en: Evangelical shares the messenger root: eu (good) + angelos (messenger) = good news.
normal.cn: evangelical 同出信使词根：eu（好）+ angelos（信使）= 好消息（福音）。

normal.en: Compare angelic wings with archangel's arch- (chief) prefix.
normal.cn: 比较 angelic 与 archangel 的 arch-（首领）前缀。

normal.en: Angelic patience and saintly patience describe the same rare virtue.
normal.cn: angelic patience 与 saintly patience 描述同一种难得的美德。

abstract.en: Picture soft white light around a sleeping child's face.
abstract.cn: 想象熟睡孩子面孔周围柔和的白光。

abstract.en: Hear a choir so clean it seems to come from above the ceiling.
abstract.cn: 聆听纯净得仿佛来自天花板之上的合唱。

abstract.en: Feel infinite patience, a smile that never tightens at the corners.
abstract.cn: 感受无限的耐心，一个嘴角永不僵硬的微笑。

examples.en: She sang with an angelic voice that silenced the hall.
examples.cn: 她的歌声如天籁般令全场安静。

examples.en: He endured the delay with angelic patience.
examples.cn: 他以天使般的耐心忍受了延误。

examples.en: The angelic child shared her sweets with everyone.
examples.cn: 那天使般的孩子把糖果分给了每个人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安洁丽可」——安静、洁白、美丽又可爱的天使，正是 angelic（天使般的）的画面。

root: 一般认为源自印欧词根 *her-（移动）→ 希腊语 angelos「信使」→ 拉丁语 angelus → 拉丁语 angelicus → 古法语 angelique → 英语 angelic。核心义为「天国信使（般）的」。

sensesIntro.en: From the messenger of heaven, the adjective spreads to faces, voices, kindness, patience, and even ironic masks of innocence.
sensesIntro.cn: 从天国信使出发，形容词铺展到面容、嗓音、善良、耐心，乃至带反讽的天真面具。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a glowing messenger of heaven
core.cn: 核心意象：散发柔光的天国信使

branches.en: beauty and sound of heaven
branches.cn: 天国的美与声

branches.en: virtue in character
branches.cn: 品性中的美德

branches.en: the literal religious sphere
branches.cn: 字面的宗教领域

branches.en: innocence, real or worn as a mask
branches.cn: 天真，真实或如面具

branches.en: from kindness to endless patience
branches.cn: 从善良到无限耐心

intro.cn: 英语中的 angel- 词族主要是在单一词干上加希腊、拉丁后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin angelus supplied the stem that most English forms use.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 angelus 提供了多数英语词形所用的词干。

大天使位阶高于普通天使。

items.exampleCN: 她脸上现出圣洁的平静。
